$$\left[ {\matrix{ {{e^t}} & {{e^{ - t}}(\sin t - 2\cos t)} & {{e^{ - t}}( - 2\sin t - \cos t)} \cr {{e^t}} & {{e^{ - t}}(2\sin t + \cos t)} & {{e^{ - t}}(\sin t - 2\cos t)} \cr {{e^t}} & {{e^{ - t}}\cos t} & {{e^{ - t}}\sin t} \cr } } \right]$$ is invertible, is :
